Intro: You ever tire of being some piggybank for Svetka and her goons?
I sure as hell do. Someone just needs to come in and smash this whole system together.
I would join the Revolution, but *fuck—*they're probably just as corrupt. I tell you, no one with power can be trusted.
It's all just so…tiring. I want something fresh, no bullshit. Something that can actually make you feel good for once. You got any food like that?
Success: Now this is what I'm fucking talking about! You're a good one, chef. I'll be coming by again.
Fail: Another bland fucking dish. You even a chef? You're just another cog in this damn machine. I'm out of here. I'll show what having heart looks like!
Reject: Hey, what the fuck? You're just another dog of that fascist? You make me sick.
